indicators() writes 'rejected' for every McpError, but McpClient.raw() raises McpError for a non-JSON body at ANY HTTP status (e.g. a 504 page after the request reached them) and any JSON-RPC error, which may have landed (rule 9 wants unknown); a 200 without success:true is written rejected while _served() writes an unreadable 200 unknown

comment 'a variant is determined by its own body, whatever ran on the clone before' is false now that indicators can be changed: a settings PATCH cannot reset an update_bot_indicators override, so an indicator change leaks into every later settings variant on that clone (and the reverse)

restart_refusal counts an indicators change as the new variant on its outcome alone; indicators() records effective_matches and reread in the after row but nothing reads them, so an accepted change whose read-back does not match allows a restart of the same experiment
book() counts every accepted CLOSE as an 'unaccounted' order (the close outcome carries no position_id), so affordable()'s message reports 34 phantom accepted orders; no money effect
